en.name: Official Built-ins

en.script.MirrorY.description: Mirror selected notes across the Y axis.

en.script.SideSwitch.description: Flip selected notes between Above and Below.
en.script.SideUp.label: SideUp
en.script.SideDown.label: SideDown
en.script.ToReal.label: ToReal

zh.notice.noSelection: 请先选择至少一个音符。
zh.notice.noChanges: 选中的音符没有可修改的值。

zh.script.ToTap.description: 将选中音符转换为 Tap。
zh.script.ToFlick.label: ToFlick
zh.script.ToFlick.description: 将选中音符转换为 Flick。
zh.script.ToDrag.label: ToDrag
